title: One with Shadows
html:
One with Shadows is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows you to vanish into the darkness and become  Invisible.

Description

You learn how to cast  One with Shadows.

Grants:

  •  One with Shadows (class action)

How to learn
